description:
Best for: which watched companies are hiring fastest, such as "who on my watch is hiring most this week?".
Returns: per company on the watch, open roles and roles opened and closed over 7 and 30 days, fastest first. It reads the watch's last read and the daily snapshots, never a job board, so call watch_new_roles first for fresh counts.
Input tips: {"watch_key": "hs_..."}.
Not for: starting a watch (use watch_new_roles).

watch_key.description: The watch_key an earlier call returned. Leave it out to start a new watch.
